name: Rad Balek 1.0.0 — Confiance
body:
The version that verifies itself.

- Guided setup with a live siren test + notification/battery permission help
- Reliability screen that detects an OEM-blocked alert and fixes it in one tap
- One unified home card: your wilaya + the national picture at a glance
- Offline safety guides (earthquake, fire, flood, heatwave, storm) — no network needed
- Fire maps fixed: FIRMS satellite hotspots and the fire-risk raster render again
- Smoother, lighter app (fluid transitions)

Not an official government service. In an emergency, call Protection Civile: 14 or 1021.

APK: app-release.apk (universal, all devices).
